title: Sharp Neumann eigenvalue means on triangles
summary: We prove two conjectures of Laugesen and Siudeja: the equilateral triangle uniquely maximizes the harmonic mean of the first two positive Neumann eigenvalues at fixed perimeter and their geometric mean at fixed area. The proof uses the two equilateral eigenfunctions and four projected polynomial corrections. Triangle symmetry reduces the associated variational matrices to two-by-two operations and two scalar invariants. Angular comparison and horizontal trial functions then yield the global inequalities.
